user_direction_et: Suure lisamise korral 3–4 eelvaadet ning võimalus avada kõik sama avaldaja lisamised.
publisher_occurrence_rule: At most one publisher block per snapshot/window, including the publisher announcement excerpt. A separately selected earlier window may show the publisher again.

window.older_content: Explicit previous-window or date-period navigation remains available after a long absence; seven days is a proposed initial viewport, not history deletion or a hard visibility ceiling.

snapshot_contract.late_commits: Must belong to a later snapshot; a created_at filter alone is insufficient proof.
snapshot_contract.implementation_status: Contract requirement only; concrete closed frontier/snapshot storage must be checked against source before implementation.

expand.unavailable_snapshot_behavior: Show explicit refresh state, never silently open another collection.

optional_bounded_total.scope: same publisher/window/snapshot and currently authorized public rows

newness.means: Currently visible initial-publication events newer than the current snapshot frontier.
newness.persistent_seen_tracking: If implemented, record only individually observed/opened typed canonical item keys under an explicit criterion. Do not advance a global all-read watermark from four newest previews.
newness.scope: own viewer account/profile; no shared browser-wide feed_last_viewed_at
newness.persistent_read_state_status: Separate proposed contract, not an established user decision or implemented feature.

volume_scenario.while_browsing: Original group and expansion remain at original publication frontier; show a non-intrusive availability banner.
volume_scenario.after_explicit_refresh: One refreshed publisher block can contain all 105 still eligible period publications; four newest previews.

changes.edit_or_price_change: Update allowed displayed fields; preserve first-publication event and order.
changes.renewal_or_reactivation_or_paid_highligh: No new news event for the same original listing.
changes.expiry_or_hidden_content: Exclude currently ineligible rows and replace preview only from same cohort.
changes.block_or_unavailable_account: Remove affected group/content immediately; recheck detail/media.
changes.empty_group: Omit group without leaking removed counts.
changes.follow_or_account_or_profile_change: Retire old snapshot and load the new authorized scope.

visual_layout_spec.purpose: Optional inline illustration only, not a product implementation.

publisher_card.optional_notice: At most one short excerpt in same publisher block; separate exact-window notices action.
